propositions: code-review-verify spec emits only {verifications: [...]} with no decision polarity, causing all cases to be scored as advisory regardless of gold label
the two verify test cases (V-real-defect and V-clean-rename) both sit in the scored gold set but both map to advisory, guaranteeing a recall miss on the gold-block case
mapping non-empty verifications list to block would fix the recall miss but simultaneously misclassify the gold-advisory case as block, creating a false accept
code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus by a named separate mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to preserve the reason and prevent future silent re-admission
after exclusion n_gold decreases from 28 to 26 but remains above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20, and gating verdicts remain unchanged because the missed case was symmetric across both arms
